title: Angelus, 1st November 2026, Solemnity of All Saints
pray: Let us invoke the intercession of these martyrs for all missionaries of the Gospel.
Let us entrust to Mary, Queen of Peace and of All Saints, all those throughout the world who are suffering because of war.

During these days, let us feel united in the Communion of Saints with the immense family of our brothers and sisters who have gone before us on our earthly pilgrimage, and let us pray for the departed, especially those whom no one remembers.
